say:1:1013809001:1.text: Sorry... I did my best, but I couldn't protect everyone properly...
say:1:1013809001:1.source_cn: 抱歉……我竭尽全力，还是没能好好保护诸位……

say:3:1013809002:1.text: The giant golem is too powerful, we need something on the same level to counter it.
say:3:1013809002:1.source_cn: 巨型魔偶的力量过于强大，必须有同等的力量才可能对抗。

say:5:1013809003:2.text: Seems like the odds are against us. Should we retreat? Or call for reinforcements?
say:5:1013809003:2.source_cn: 看来我们几个是没有胜算了，对吗？先离开这里吧？敌人太过...

say:6:1013809004:1.text: You can hand me over to the Temple in exchange for more reinforcements! I promise I won't stray this time...
say:6:1013809004:1.source_cn: 你可以把我交给圣堂，让他们再多派人来！这次，我保证哪也...

say:7:1013809005:2.text: I won't leave. I swore to Dura—I'll atone for any sins, be they mine or yours.
say:7:1013809005:2.source_cn: 我不会走，我曾以我的骑士之心，向艾雅起誓——我会赎清罪...

say:8:1013809006:2.text: The Faith Stone has become my sin. But this time... I have to do what's right.
say:8:1013809006:2.source_cn: 圣石已然成为了我的罪孽。但这次……我一定要做正确的事。

choice_prompt:9:1013809006.text: The Faith Stone has become my sin. But this time... I have to do what's right.
